_llm_instructions: Fill out the 'value' properties for each field in this Risk Report template based on the provided project context.

Executive summary.guidance: A statement describing the overall project risk exposure and major individual risks affecting the project, along with the proposed responses for trends.

Overall project risk.guidance: Provide a description of the overall risk of the project, including: • High-level statement of trends • Significant drivers of overall risk • Recommended responses to overall risk

Individual project risks.guidance: Analyze and summarize information associated with individual project risks, including: • Number of risks in each box of the probability impact matrix • Key metrics • Active risks • Newly closed risks • Risks distribution by category, objective, and score • Most-critical risks and changes since last report • Recommended responses to top risks

Quantitative analysis.guidance: Summarize the results of quantitative risk analysis, including: • Results from quantitative assessments (S-curve, tornado, etc.) • Probability of meeting key project objectives • Drivers of cost and schedule outcomes • Proposed responses

Reserve status.guidance: Describe the reserve status, such as reserve used, reserve remaining, and an assessment of the adequacy of the reserve.

Risk audit results (if applicable).guidance: Summarize the results of a risk audit of the risk management processes.
